submitted.rationale: At 2.4 eV, the likely active phase is BiVO4. XRD on index 0 and index 73 showed BiVO4-like peaks near Q≈1.32–1.35 and 2.03–2.04. Photocurrent went up as Cu fell and Bi rose: index 73 gave 3.6 µA, index 0 gave 10.0 µA and index 3 gave 12.4 µA, the highest measured.

rejected.reason: BiVO4-like XRD pattern, but it measured 10.0 µA, below index 3.
BiVO4 plus extra Cu-related phases; it measured only 3.6 µA.
XRD on index 28 suggested CuBi2O4 (tentative peak match), which is a p-type photocathode and so a poor photoanode. Not measured for photocurrent.
Cu-vanadate peaks in XRD. These are known to be weaker photoanodes than BiVO4, and the photocurrent trend fell as Cu increased. Not measured for photocurrent.
